messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Severity=P2 | us-west-2 inference pool reporting elevated 5xx and inference_error counts. error_rate=17% over 5m. paging on-call.

alex: oncall here, looking at logs now. initial glance: repeated kvcache load + OOMs on g4dn.xlarge nodes. collecting traces.

alex: immediate mitigation: shifted 25% traffic to gen-fallback-1 and disabled aggressive batching. command used:
```
redwoodctl route update --pool us-west-2-a --policy split --variants primary=75,fallback=25
redwoodctl autoscale set --pool us-west-2-a --min 2 --max 6 --disable-batcher-temporal
```

maya: can you paste trace links and metric dashboards? will splice into incident doc.

alex: traces: https://internal.traces/r/1815004321; dashboards pinned in incident doc. After split: error_rate dropped to ~3.8%, p99 latency +60ms.

devon: runtime note: seeing repeated large prefix fetches from ~5 tenants. kvcache hit-rate collapses when these prefixes arrive concurrently -> eviction storms. hypothesis: long-prefix churn causing working set blowup.

casey: infra observed two node-level OOM kills around 1815003600-1815003700 on g4dn instances. likely correlates. raising infra ticket to check instance sizing and oom logs.

lina: any customer impact? are responses truncated or 5xx bubbled to users?

alex: CS reported customer-eta: CustomerX had ~45 failed completions over the 12m window, CustomerY ~10. Some client-side retries increased load. No payment or billing impact flagged yet.

harry (CS): confirming CustomerX reported intermittent failed responses in product metrics. we've notified them with a heads-up. I'll coordinate a detailed follow-up after postmortem.

sam: marking as P2. propose two meetings: quick triage tomorrow 09:30 PST (30m) and a deep postmortem Friday 11:00 PST (90m). who can make the triage?

maya: SRE can do tomorrow 09:30.

devon: runtime team prefers Friday deep-dive for root cause; can join 09:30 for triage to align owners.

sam: ok will create calendar invites and postmortem doc. Creating action items now with rough sizing/priority. We'll refine in triage.

sam: ACTIONS (pre-triage draft):
1) INT-3107: Root cause analysis for KV cache thrash and eviction policy misbehavior. Owners: devon + maya. Size: M. Priority: High. Tie: Q2 reliability epic.
2) INT-3108: Short-term prefix size parsing cap and request rejection/backpressure for extreme lengths (hotfix). Owner: devon. Size: XS. Priority: High (mitigate memory).
3) INT-3109: Infra reserved-pool PoC for long-prefix requests + routing logic. Owner: casey. Size: L. Priority: High. Roadmap alignment required.
4) INT-3110: Auto-fallback weighter: automatic traffic split adjustment when errors spike. Owner: alex + devops. Size: S. Priority: Medium. Candidate next sprint.
5) INT-3111: Customer comms and incident timeline to impacted tenants. Owner: harry (CS) + lina. Size: XS. Priority: High (24-48h).
6) INT-3112: Runbook update for kv-cache indicators and preemptive eviction trigger. Owner: maya. Size: S. Priority: Medium.

lina: I'll draft the customer note and include impact metrics + timeline. Harry, can CS confirm exact account IDs to include?

harry (CS): will confirm in doc shortly.

devon: posted a small mitigation PR to cap parsed prefix size to 32k tokens for now (hotfix). PR: https://git/rep/pull/5240 . tagging runtime reviewers. Size: XS.

casey: infra notes: reserved pool will need placement constraints + capacity sizing; estimate 4 workdays for PoC and additional infra review. Opening planning ticket INT-3113 to track infra dependencies and capacity billing implications.

maya: for tomorrow's triage let's agree on acceptance criteria for INT-3107/3109: RCA with reproducible test case, mitigation plan, rollout plan, and regression test. Also define which metrics must be stable (error_rate <1% and p99 latency within +100ms of baseline) before closing.

alex: I'm handing off in ~25m. maya taking lead. alex -> maya: ensure autoscaler re-enabled when stable.

maya: taking over. will monitor dashboards and adjust alerts to account for fallback variant. Will also add a temporary dashboard tile for per-tenant prefix distribution.

sam: postmortem doc created: https://docs.internal/postmortems/INT-3107 . Each INT ticket must include: summary, hypothesis, test plan, mitigation, rollout steps, and Q-epic mapping.

sam: scheduling note: triage 09:30 PST tomorrow (recorded) + deep remediation Friday 11:00 PST. Please RSVP.

alex: quick reminder: re-enable batcher autoscale after we confirm stable traffic patterns: command to re-enable:
```
redwoodctl autoscale set --pool us-west-2-a --min 2 --max 12 --enable-batcher-temporal
```

lina: customer comm draft posted. linking to incident doc and timeline.

harry (CS): CS will send acknowledgment to impacted customers within 6 hours and follow up with detailed postmortem once ready.

devops: will triage automation for auto-fallback weighter and estimate story points during grooming; likely a 3-4 day implementation.

casey: created INT-3113 infra planning ticket and linked to INT-3109.

devon: adding notes to runtime repo about cache eviction heuristics and will instrument additional metrics (per-tenant kvcache fills, eviction counts, memory pressure).

sam: summary and next steps captured. we'll refine owners/sizes in triage. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated (fallback routing active). Postmortem required. labels: P2; mitigated_at=1815007899
